parameters.content:
## Send n8n failures to Linear

Configure the team UUID, stable instance key and HTTPS n8n origin. Bind an HTTP Header Auth credential named Authorization to every HTTP Request node. Leave createIssue false for preview.

Select this workflow in the error settings of workflows you own. Test with a controlled automatic failure. Raw errors and payloads are never sent to Linear.

Matching a previous issue prevents sequential duplicates. Serialize executions; simultaneous searches and creates are not atomic. After a timeout, search Linear before retrying. See the companion guide.
